text:
Maya - People Ops: Ibrahim asked if we can make an out-of-cycle base + title + equity grant effective 2026-07-01 even though candidate's start is 2026-07-15. also the hire is on a dependent visa that requires sponsorship start dates. what do we need to approve an earlier effective date? cc @Sam @Tess

Ibrahim - Eng Manager: manager wants SWE II -> SWE III, base increase, and to issue first equity tranche effective 7/1 to align with team comp band. candidate accepted offer 6/25 and has signed docs but visa activation/flag starts 7/15. manager prefers retro to month-start.

Tess - Comp: short: salary retro possible with signed amendment that states effective date. equity is trickier: we cannot backdate grant if it changes eligibility, or if grant date precedes sponsorship/start for tax/reporting. We need to check equity plan rules and confirm with Legal. We'll draft backpay calc after amendment.

Sam - Payroll: operationally we can do a manual retro for July if docs arrive before cutoff 2026-07-25 23:59 PST. required: signed amendment, comp calc, payroll reason code, and immigration confirmation if visa impacts payroll start. payroll command example:

```
manual_retro --eid 055123 --period 2026-07 --retro_start 2026-07-01 --amount 820.00 --note "OC retro salary"
```

Do NOT run until People Ops confirms Legal/Immigration OK.

Diego - HRBP: benefits cannot start before actual hire on record; enrollment will be 7/15. Title in HRIS can be set with retro date if amendment allows, but inform candidate about benefits timing.

Anya - Legal (Immigration): visa/sponsorship note: if the employee is not authorized to work before 7/15, we cannot pay salary for earlier dates nor backdate Social/Tax filings. For dependent visas that become active on 7/15, any payment for prior days could expose the company. We can consider a one-time sign-on payment tied to hire date instead of retro salary, but that has tax/equity implications. Please provide country and visa type and I'll review. Amendment should include an acknowledgement about tax/immigration risk.

Ibrahim - Eng Manager: thanks. country = UK, visa = Skilled Worker (dependant previously). Candidate confirmed paperwork. If we can't pay retro, is there a hybrid: title effective 7/1 but salary paid from 7/15?

Tess - Comp: yes that's reasonable: set title effective 7/1 in HRIS, salary effective 7/15 for payroll, and equity grant date = 7/15 (or grant approval date). Document rationale in the amendment so comp reports reflect it.

Sam - Payroll: agree. Payroll will only process salary from date on payroll record. If People Ops wants a one-time sign-on to bridge the difference, note it in amendment and we'll calculate withholding accordingly.

people-bot: Reminder: payroll cutoff for July manual adjustments is 2026-07-25 23:59 PST :bell:

Maya - People Ops: action items: 1) Ibrahim uploads signed amendment with explicit effective dates and visa disclosure. 2) Tess posts backpay calc if any. 3) Anya confirms UK-specific statement. 4) Sam processes payroll after People Ops clearance. I'll keep this thread open until done. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
